source.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah! Sing to YHWH a new song, his praise in [the] assembly of [the] faithful.

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a new song, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} praise in the assembly of the faithful!
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; sing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} praise where the faithful gather!
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} when {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful people meet together!

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange dans l’assemblée des fidèles !
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau ; chantez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange là où les fidèles se rassemblent !
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau ! Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} quand {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles se réunissent !

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya, \q sifa {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} katika kusanyiko la waaminifu!
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya; \q imbeni sifa {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} mahali waaminifu wanapokusanyika!
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya! \q Msifuni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waaminifu wanapokutana pamoja!

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un cántico nuevo, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alabanza en la asamblea de los fieles.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un cántico nuevo; ¡{{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alabanza donde se reúnen los fieles!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un canto nuevo! ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} cuando {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo fiel se reúna!

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một bài ca mới, \q [hát] lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong hội của những người trung tín!
vi.B: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một bài ca mới; \q hãy hát lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nơi những người trung tín nhóm họp!
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Hãy hát một bài ca mới cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khi những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhóm lại với nhau!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래를, \q 신실한 이들의 모임에서 그분께 드릴 찬양을 노래하여라!
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래를 불러라. \q 신실한 사람들이 모인 곳에서 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래를 불러 드려라! \q 그분의 신실한 백성이 함께 모일 때 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Aleluia! Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} um cântico novo, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} louvor na assembleia dos fiéis!
pt.B: Aleluia! Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} um cântico novo; cantem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} louvor onde os fiéis se reúnem!
pt.R: Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}! Cantem um cântico novo {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}} quando o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo fiel se reúne!

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ! {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ ቅኔ ዘምሩ፤ \q ምስጋናውን በታማኞች ጉባኤ [ዘምሩ]!
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ! {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ፤ \q ታማኞቹ በሚሰበሰቡበት ምስጋናውን ዘምሩ!
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ! {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ! \q ታማኝ ሕዝቡ በአንድነት ሲሰበሰቡ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए एक नया गीत गाओ, भक्तों की सभा में उनकी स्तुति [गाओ]!
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए नया गीत गाओ; जहाँ विश्वासयोग्य लोग इकट्ठे होते हैं, वहाँ उनकी स्तुति गाओ!
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए एक नया गीत गाओ! जब उनके विश्वासयोग्य लोग इकट्ठे हों, तब उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} новую песнь, хвалу {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} в собрании верных!
ru.B: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} новую песнь; пойте {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} хвалу там, где собираются верные!
ru.R: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} новую песню! Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, когда {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} верные люди собираются вместе!

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！新しい歌を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え。誠実な者たちの集会で、その方への賛美を[歌え]！
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！新しい歌を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え。誠実な人たちの集うところで、その方への賛美を歌え！
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！新しい歌を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌おう！その方に忠実な人たちが集まるときに、その方を賛美しよう！

uk.L: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! Співайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} хвалу в зібранні вірних!
uk.B: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! Заспівайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню; співайте {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} хвалу там, де збираються вірні!
uk.R: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! Заспівайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню! Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, коли {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} віддані люди збираються разом!

decisions.choice: Praise Yah: hallelu-yah, a call to praise the LORD
decisions.reason: The words (hallelu yah) are a command to a group, "praise Yah"; Yah is the short form of the divine name (YHWH). Psalms 146-150 each open and close with this call. Here in Psalm 149 the renderings translate it, as "Praise the LORD", rather than keep it as the borrowed word "Hallelujah".
A new song answers a new act of God (40:4; 98:1). Here it is sung by the gathered people.

decisions.choice: assembly: the people gathered for worship
decisions.reason: The word (qahal) is the whole community gathered together (22:23).

decisions.choice: the faithful: people of loyal love
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is related to chesed, loyal love: people who hold fast to the LORD in love and loyalty (4:4).

decisions.choice: "những người trung tín" for the faithful at every level, through Psalms 148-149
decisions.reason: The faithful are people of loyal love (see the meaning decision); "trung tín" says that loyalty plainly, where "các thánh" (the saints) would suggest holiness instead.

decisions.choice: um cântico novo
decisions.reason: As 33:3 and 96:1 have it in Portuguese (m2). "A assembleia" is qahal, as the Old Testament terms set it.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 149.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: hallelu-yah translated, "እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ!" (alternative "ያህን አመስግኑ!"), as 146:1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 146 (decision there): the renderings of Psalm 149 translate the call (meaning decision m1), so the Amharic does too, with the short form Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!
decisions.reason: As in 146:1, the call that opens and closes Psalms 146-150 keeps one form at every level.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the psalm speaks of God with the honorific plural.

decisions.choice: सभा; भक्त (L), विश्वासयोग्य लोग (B, R)
decisions.reason: Qahal is सभा, as the Pentateuch note settles; the chasidim are भक्त at Literal and "faithful people" at Balanced and Readable, as in 145:10.

decisions.choice: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!
decisions.reason: As in 146:1: one wording for hallelu-yah at every level through Psalms 146-150 (m1).

decisions.choice: хвалу ему (L, B)
decisions.reason: "His praise" is the praise given to him; Russian "его хвала" could be read as praise he gives, so Literal and Balanced say "хвалу ему".

decisions.choice: hallelu-yah, one fixed form through Psalms 146-150: "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！" (L, B), "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule (PSA-1, PSA-11): Yah is {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}, the call 〜せよ (L, B), R 〜しよう since God's people are called; the closing Hallel takes the exclamation form used in 111-113 and 135, the same at the head and foot of every psalm.

decisions.choice: shiru … shir chadash "新しい歌を…歌え" (L, B) as 96:1, "歌おう" (R); biqhal chasidim "誠実な者たちの集会" (L), "誠実な人たちの集うところ" (B), "その方に忠実な人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: A new song as 33:3 and 96:1 (m2); God's own people are called, so R uses 〜しよう (PSA-1); chasidim in the Psalter forms (m4).

source.text: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let Israel rejoice in its Maker; let [the] sons of Zion be glad in their King.

en.L: Let Israel rejoice in its Maker; let the sons of Zion be glad in their King.
en.B: Let Israel be glad in the one who made it; let Zion's people rejoice in their King.
en.R: Let the people of Israel be happy, because God made them. Let the people of Zion be glad, because God is their King.

fr.L: Qu’Israël se réjouisse en celui qui l’a fait ; que les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Sion exultent en leur Roi !
fr.B: Qu’Israël se réjouisse en celui qui l’a créé ; que le peuple de Sion soit dans l’allégresse à cause de son Roi !
fr.R: Que le peuple d’Israël soit heureux, parce que Dieu l’a fait. Que le peuple de Sion se réjouisse, parce que Dieu est son Roi.

sw.L: Israeli na amfurahie Muumba wake; \q wana wa Sayuni na washangilie katika Mfalme wao.
sw.B: Israeli na afurahi katika yule aliyemuumba; \q watu wa Sayuni na washangilie Mfalme wao.
sw.R: Watu wa Israeli na wafurahi, kwa sababu Mungu aliwaumba. \q Watu wa Sayuni na washangilie, kwa sababu Mungu ni Mfalme wao.

es.L: Que Israel se alegre en su Hacedor; que los hijos de Sion se regocijen en su Rey.
es.B: Que Israel se alegre en el que lo hizo; que el pueblo de Sion se regocije en su Rey.
es.R: Que el pueblo de Israel esté feliz, porque Dios lo hizo. Que el pueblo de Sion se alegre, porque Dios es su Rey.

vi.L: Nguyện Y-sơ-ra-ên vui mừng nơi Đấng Tạo Hóa của mình; \q nguyện con cái Si-ôn hớn hở nơi Vua của họ.
vi.B: Nguyện Y-sơ-ra-ên vui mừng nơi Đấng đã tạo nên mình; \q nguyện dân Si-ôn hớn hở nơi Vua của họ.
vi.R: Nguyện dân Y-sơ-ra-ên vui mừng, vì Đức Chúa Trời đã dựng nên họ. \q Nguyện dân Si-ôn hân hoan, vì Đức Chúa Trời là Vua của họ.

ko.L: 이스라엘은 자기를 지으신 분을 기뻐하고, \q 시온의 자녀들은 그들의 왕을 즐거워하여라.
ko.B: 이스라엘은 자기를 만드신 분 안에서 기뻐하고, \q 시온 백성은 그들의 왕 안에서 즐거워하여라.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 기뻐하여라. 하나님께서 그들을 만드셨기 때문이다. \q 시온 백성은 즐거워하여라. 하나님께서 그들의 왕이시기 때문이다.

pt.L: Que Israel se alegre no seu Criador; que os filhos de Sião exultem no seu Rei.
pt.B: Que Israel se alegre naquele que o fez; que o povo de Sião festeje o seu Rei.
pt.R: Que o povo de Israel fique feliz, porque Deus o fez. Que o povo de Sião se alegre, porque Deus é o seu Rei.

am.L: እስራኤል በፈጣሪው ደስ ይበለው፤ \q የጽዮን ልጆች በንጉሣቸው ሐሤት ያድርጉ።
am.B: እስራኤል በሠራው ደስ ይበለው፤ \q የጽዮን ሕዝብ በንጉሣቸው ሐሤት ያድርጉ።
am.R: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ደስ ይበላቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሠርቷቸዋልና። \q የጽዮን ሕዝብ ሐሤት ያድርጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ንጉሣቸው ነውና።

hi.L: इस्राएल अपने रचनेवाले में आनंद करे; सिय्योन के पुत्र अपने राजा में मगन हों।
hi.B: इस्राएल उनमें आनंदित हो जिन्होंने उसे बनाया; सिय्योन के लोग अपने राजा में आनंद मनाएँ।
hi.R: इस्राएल के लोग ख़ुश हों, क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने उन्हें बनाया है। सिय्योन के लोग आनंदित हों, क्योंकि परमेश्वर उनके राजा हैं।

ru.L: Пусть веселится Израиль о своём Создателе; пусть сыны Сиона радуются о своём Царе.
ru.B: Пусть Израиль радуется тому, кто его создал; пусть народ Сиона ликует о своём Царе.
ru.R: Пусть израильтяне будут счастливы, потому что Бог создал их. Пусть жители Сиона радуются, потому что Бог — их Царь.

ja.L: イスラエルは、自分を造られた方を喜び、シオンの子らは、自分たちの王を楽しむように。
ja.B: イスラエルが、自分を造られた方を喜び、シオンの人々が、自分たちの王を喜び祝うように。
ja.R: イスラエルの人々が、神に造られたことを喜ぶように。シオンの人々が、神が自分たちの王であることを喜ぶように。

uk.L: Нехай радіє Ізраїль своїм Творцем; нехай сини Сіону веселяться своїм Царем.
uk.B: Нехай Ізраїль тішиться тим, хто його створив; нехай народ Сіону радіє своїм Царем.
uk.R: Нехай народ Ізраїля радіє, бо Бог створив його. Нехай народ Сіону веселиться, бо Бог — їхній Цар.

decisions.choice: its Maker: a plural form for the one God
decisions.reason: The word ("its makers", 'osav) is plural in form, as with "Maker" in Job 35:10 and Isaiah 54:5, a plural that expresses greatness, like 'elohim, "God". God made Israel a people (95:6; 100:3).

decisions.choice: the sons of Zion: the people of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The "children" of a city are its people (147:13).

decisions.choice: because God made them; because God is their King
alternatives: in its Maker; in their King
decisions.reason: Readable says why they rejoice and names God.

decisions.choice: "enfants" by default, "fils" as the gender alternative, for "the sons of Zion" at Literal
decisions.reason: The sons of Zion are the people of Jerusalem, men and women, as the meaning decision says. French follows the form it uses for "the sons of Israel" (148:14).

decisions.choice: "시온의 자녀들" for "the sons of Zion"
decisions.reason: The phrase means the people of Jerusalem, women and men (meaning decision), and the English Literal has no setting here; "자녀들" says it without needing a span.

decisions.choice: "ፈጣሪው" (its Maker, L), "የሠራው" (B), in the singular
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plural form is a plural of greatness for the one God (meaning decision m1); Amharic says it with the singular.

decisions.choice: be'osaw "自分を造られた方" (L, B); benei-Tsiyyon "シオンの子ら" (L), "シオンの人々" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The plural form names the one God (m1), so no plural in Japanese; the sons of Zion are its people (m2). Jussives 〜ように (PSA-12).

source.text: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them praise his name with dancing; with tambourine and lyre let them make music to him.

en.L: Let them praise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name with dancing; with tambourine and lyre let them make music to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Let them praise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name in dance and make music for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on tambourine and lyre.
en.R: Let them dance as they praise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. Let them play music for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on tambourines and lyres.

fr.L: Qu’ils louent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom avec des danses ; avec tambourin et lyre, qu’ils jouent pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !
fr.B: Qu’ils louent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom en dansant et qu’ils jouent pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} du tambourin et de la lyre !
fr.R: Qu’ils dansent en louant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ! Qu’ils jouent pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} du tambourin et de la lyre !

sw.L: Na walisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa kucheza; \q kwa matari na kinubi na wampigie muziki.
sw.B: Na walisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa kucheza \q na kumpigia muziki kwa matari na kinubi.
sw.R: Na wacheze wanapolisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Na wampigie muziki kwa matari na vinubi.

es.L: Que alaben {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre con danzas; con pandero y lira {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} canten salmos.
es.B: Que alaben {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre con danzas y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} toquen música con pandero y lira.
es.R: Que bailen mientras alaban {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} toquen música con panderos y liras.

vi.L: Nguyện họ ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng điệu múa; \q bằng trống lục lạc và đàn lia, nguyện họ đàn ca cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nguyện họ nhảy múa ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và đánh trống lục lạc, gảy đàn lia ca hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nguyện họ vừa nhảy múa vừa ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Nguyện họ đánh trống lục lạc và gảy đàn lia cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그들이 춤추며 그분의 이름을 찬양하고, \q 소고와 수금으로 그분께 찬송하게 하여라.
ko.B: 그들이 춤을 추며 그분의 이름을 찬양하고, \q 소고와 수금으로 그분께 연주하게 하여라.
ko.R: 그들이 춤을 추면서 그분의 이름을 찬양하게 하여라. \q 소고와 수금을 연주하며 그분께 음악을 들려 드리게 하여라.

pt.L: Que eles louvem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome com danças; com tamborim e lira toquem para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.B: Que eles louvem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome dançando e toquem música para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} com tamborim e lira.
pt.R: Que eles dancem enquanto louvam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. Que toquem música para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} com tamborins e liras.

am.L: ስሙን በሽብሸባ ያመስግኑ፤ \q በከበሮና በበገና ይዘምሩለት።
am.B: ስሙን በሽብሸባ ያመስግኑ፤ \q በከበሮና በበገናም ይዘምሩለት።
am.R: እየጨፈሩ ስሙን ያመስግኑ። \q ከበሮና በገና እየተጫወቱ ይዘምሩለት።

hi.L: वे नाचते हुए उनके नाम की स्तुति करें; डफ़ और वीणा के साथ वे उनके लिए बजाएँ।
hi.B: वे नाच के साथ उनके नाम की स्तुति करें और डफ़ और वीणा पर उनके लिए संगीत बजाएँ।
hi.R: वे उनके नाम की स्तुति करते हुए नाचें। वे डफ़ और वीणाओं पर उनके लिए संगीत बजाएँ।

ru.L: Пусть хвалят {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя с пляской; на бубне и лире пусть играют {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.
ru.B: Пусть хвалят {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя в танце и играют {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} на бубне и лире.
ru.R: Пусть они танцуют, восхваляя {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя. Пусть играют {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} музыку на бубнах и лирах.

ja.L: 彼らが、踊りをもってその方の名を賛美し、タンバリンと竪琴で、その方にほめ歌を歌うように。
ja.B: 彼らが、踊りながらその方の名を賛美し、タンバリンと竪琴で、その方にほめ歌を歌うように。
ja.R: 彼らが、踊りながら、その方の名を賛美するように。タンバリンを打ち鳴らし、たて琴をひいて、その方のために歌うように。

uk.L: Нехай хвалять {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя танцями; на бубні й лірі нехай грають {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.
uk.B: Нехай хвалять {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя в танці й грають {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} на бубні й лірі.
uk.R: Нехай вони танцюють, хвалячи {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя. Нехай грають {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} на бубнах і лірах.

decisions.choice: dancing and the tambourine
decisions.reason: The tambourine (tof) was a hand drum, played with dancing at times of victory and joy, as when Miriam led the women after the crossing of the sea (Exodus 15:20).

decisions.choice: lyre: a small stringed instrument
decisions.reason: As in 147:7.

decisions.choice: "trống lục lạc" for the tambourine and "đàn lia" for the lyre
decisions.reason: The tambourine is a hand drum with jingles, played for dancing (see the meaning decision); "trống lục lạc" names it plainly. "đàn lia" is the lyre, as in Psalm 137:2.

decisions.choice: "소고" for the tambourine, "수금" for the lyre (also 150:3-4)
decisions.reason: "소고" is the established Korean word for the hand drum of the Bible; "수금" as in 137:2 and 147:7.

decisions.choice: "ሽብሸባ" (dancing, L, B), "እየጨፈሩ" (R); "ከበሮ" (tambourine); "በገና" (lyre)
decisions.reason: As Exodus 15:20 on main, Miriam's tambourine and dances (meaning decision m1); the lyre is "በገና" as 147:7.

decisions.choice: डफ़; वीणा
decisions.reason: The tambourine (tof) is डफ़, as in Exodus 15:20 and Psalms 68 and 81 in this translation; the lyre (kinnor) is वीणा, as in 147:7.

decisions.choice: пляска (L), танец (B, R); бубен; лира
decisions.reason: The dance and the tambourine (m1) are those of Exodus 15:20 in this translation ("с плясками" at Literal, dancing at Balanced and Readable, "бубен" at every level), and the lyre is "лира", as in 2 Samuel 6:5 and the earlier psalms.

decisions.choice: tof "タンバリン", kinnor "竪琴" (L, B), "たて琴" (R)
decisions.reason: Instrument names as 81:3 (PSA-9).

source.text: כִּֽי־רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For taking pleasure [is] YHWH in his people; he adorns [the] humble with salvation.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} takes pleasure in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} adorns the humble with salvation.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} dresses the humble in the beauty of salvation.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is happy with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. He honors humble people by saving them.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prend plaisir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pare les humbles du salut.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} trouve {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plaisir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} revêt les humbles de la beauté du salut.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est heureux de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Il honore les gens humbles en les sauvant.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hupendezwa na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q huwapamba wanyenyekevu kwa wokovu.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapendezwa na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q huwavika wanyenyekevu uzuri wa wokovu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anafurahia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Huwaheshimu watu wanyenyekevu kwa kuwaokoa.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se complace en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} adorna a los humildes con salvación.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está contento con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} viste a los humildes con la hermosura de la salvación.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está feliz con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Honra a la gente humilde salvándola.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đẹp lòng dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trang sức cho [những người] khiêm nhu bằng sự cứu rỗi.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hài lòng về dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mặc cho người khiêm nhu vẻ đẹp của sự cứu rỗi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vui lòng về dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài tôn trọng những người khiêm nhường bằng cách cứu họ.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 기뻐하시고, \q 겸손한 이들을 구원으로 아름답게 꾸미신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 기뻐하시고, \q 겸손한 사람들에게 구원의 아름다움을 입혀 주신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 백성을 기뻐하신다. \q 겸손한 사람들을 구원하셔서 그들을 높여 주신다.

pt.L: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tem prazer no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} adorna os humildes com salvação.
pt.B: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se agrada do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} veste os humildes com a beleza da salvação.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fica feliz com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. Ele honra as pessoas humildes salvando-as.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝቡ ደስ ይሰኛልና፤ \q ትሑታንን በማዳን ያስጌጣቸዋል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝቡ ደስ ይለዋልና፤ \q ትሑታንን የመዳንን ውበት ያለብሳቸዋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝቡ ደስ ይለዋል። \q ትሑት ሰዎችን በማዳን ያከብራቸዋል።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा से प्रसन्न रहते हैं; वे दीनों को उद्धार से सँवारते हैं।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा से प्रसन्न हैं; वे दीनों को उद्धार की शोभा पहनाते हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा से ख़ुश हैं। वे नम्र लोगों को बचाकर उनका सम्मान बढ़ाते हैं।

ru.L: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} благоволит к своему народу; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} украшает смиренных спасением.
ru.B: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} доволен своим народом; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} облекает смиренных в красоту спасения.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} радуется своему народу. Он оказывает честь смиренным людям, спасая их.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分の民を喜びとし、へりくだる者たちを救いで飾ってくださる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の民を喜んでおられ、へりくだる人たちを救いの輝きで装ってくださるからだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の民を喜んでくださる。へりくだる人たちを救って、誉れを与えてくださる。

uk.L: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} утішається своїм народом; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} прикрашає смиренних спасінням.
uk.B: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} задоволений своїм народом; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зодягає смиренних у красу спасіння.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} радіє своїм народом. Він шанує смиренних людей тим, що рятує їх.

decisions.choice: adorns: makes beautiful, gives honor
decisions.reason: The verb (pe'er) is to beautify or glorify (Isaiah 55:5; 60:9). God's rescue is the honor he puts on the lowly.

decisions.choice: salvation: rescue, victory
decisions.reason: The word (yeshu'ah) is rescue from danger, and so victory over enemies, which verses 6-9 go on to describe.

decisions.choice: the humble: the lowly who depend on God
decisions.reason: As in 147:6.

decisions.choice: honors humble people by saving them
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of adorning means (m1).

decisions.choice: yefa'er "飾ってくださる" (L), "装ってくださる" (B), "誉れを与えてくださる" (R); 'anavim "へりくだる者たち" (L), "へりくだる人たち" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Adorn, give honor (m1); salvation as rescue and victory (m2); "飾られる" would read as a passive.

records.literal_gloss: Let [the] faithful exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their beds.

en.L: Let the faithful exult in glory; let them shout for joy on their beds.
en.B: Let the faithful be jubilant in their glory; let them cry out with joy as they lie on their beds.
en.R: Let God's faithful people celebrate the honor {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives them. Let them sing happily even as they lie in bed.

fr.L: Que les fidèles exultent dans la gloire ; qu’ils crient de joie sur leurs couches !
fr.B: Que les fidèles soient dans l’allégresse de leur gloire ; qu’ils poussent des cris de joie, couchés sur leur lit !
fr.R: Que les fidèles de Dieu fêtent l’honneur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donne ! Qu’ils chantent de joie même quand ils sont couchés dans leur lit !

sw.L: Waaminifu na washangilie katika utukufu; \q na wapige kelele za furaha vitandani mwao.
sw.B: Waaminifu na wafurahi sana katika utukufu wao; \q na walie kwa furaha wanapolala vitandani mwao.
sw.R: Watu waaminifu wa Mungu na washerehekee heshima anayowapa. \q Na waimbe kwa furaha hata wanapolala vitandani.

es.L: Que los fieles se regocijen en la gloria; que griten de alegría sobre sus camas.
es.B: Que los fieles se llenen de júbilo en su gloria; que griten de alegría acostados en sus camas.
es.R: Que el pueblo fiel de Dios celebre el honor que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le da. Que cante feliz aun acostado en la cama.

vi.L: Nguyện những người trung tín hân hoan trong vinh quang; \q nguyện họ reo vui trên giường mình.
vi.B: Nguyện những người trung tín mừng rỡ trong vinh dự của họ; \q nguyện họ reo vui ngay khi nằm trên giường.
vi.R: Nguyện những người trung tín của Đức Chúa Trời vui mừng về vinh dự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ. \q Nguyện họ vui vẻ ca hát ngay cả khi nằm trên giường.

ko.L: 신실한 이들은 영광 가운데 기뻐 뛰고, \q 그들의 잠자리에서 기뻐 외치게 하여라.
ko.B: 신실한 사람들은 그들의 영광 가운데 크게 기뻐하고, \q 잠자리에 누워서도 기뻐 외치게 하여라.
ko.R: 하나님의 신실한 백성은 그분께서 주신 영광을 기뻐하여라. \q 잠자리에 누워서도 즐겁게 노래하여라.

pt.L: Que os fiéis exultem em glória; que gritem de alegria nos seus leitos.
pt.B: Que os fiéis se rejubilem na sua glória; que gritem de alegria deitados nas suas camas.
pt.R: Que o povo fiel de Deus celebre a honra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe dá. Que cante feliz mesmo quando estiver deitado na cama.

ja.L: 誠実な者たちは、栄光のうちに喜び勇み、その寝床の上で喜び歌うように。
ja.B: 誠実な人たちが、その栄光の中で喜び躍り、寝床の上でも喜びの声をあげるように。
ja.R: 神に忠実な人たちが、神が与えてくださる誉れを喜び祝うように。床に横になっているときにも、喜んで歌うように。

hi.B: उनके कंठ में ऐसे गीत हों जो परमेश्वर को ऊँचा उठाते हैं, और उनके हाथों में दोधारी तलवार थमी हो,

ru.L: [Пусть будут] высокие хвалы Бога в их гортани и обоюдоострый меч в их руке,
ru.B: с песнями, возносящими Бога, в устах и с обоюдоострым мечом в руках,
ru.R: Пусть они громко хвалят Бога, держа в руках острый меч.

ja.L: 神をあがめる歌が彼らの喉にあり、もろ刃の剣が彼らの手にあるように。
ja.B: 彼らが、神をあがめる歌を口にし、もろ刃の剣を手にするように。
ja.R: 彼らは、鋭い剣を手に持ちながら、神を賛美して叫ぶべきだ。

uk.L: [Нехай] високі хвали Богові [будуть] у їхньому горлі, і двосічний меч — у їхній руці,
uk.B: з піснями, що підносять Бога, у їхніх устах і двосічним мечем у їхніх руках,
uk.R: Вони мають вигукувати хвалу Богові, тримаючи гострий меч у руках.

decisions.choice: high praises: praises that lift God high
decisions.reason: The word (romemot) is from the verb "exalt" (145:1): praise that lifts God up.

decisions.choice: a sword of two edges
decisions.reason: A sword sharpened on both sides (Judges 3:16) was a weapon for close combat. The praising people are pictured as an army ready for battle.

decisions.choice: praise and the sword: God's judgment through his people
decisions.reason: Verses 6-9 picture God's faithful people, armed and praising, carrying out his judgment on nations and kings who oppose him, as Israel's wars are described in Joshua and Judges. Elsewhere Scripture keeps vengeance as God's own (Deuteronomy 32:35, 41-43) and looks for the day when nations will no longer train for war (Isaiah 2:4). The New Testament speaks of the word of God as a sword (Ephesians 6:17; Hebrews 4:12) and tells believers to leave vengeance to God (Romans 12:19). The renderings do not soften the psalm's words.

decisions.choice: a sharp sword
decisions.reason: Readable gives the point of the picture: a sword sharp on both edges.

decisions.choice: "እግዚአብሔር" for El without a span; "ሁለት አፍ ያለው ሰይፍ" (two-edged sword)
decisions.reason: El named without a possessor is "እግዚአብሔር" as elsewhere in the Psalms, and a divine_name span is used only for YHWH; the sword is worded as Hebrews 4:12 on main ("ሁለት አፍ").

decisions.choice: The run-on of 149:6-9 is split: 149:6 is a wish ending with 。 (L, B) or a 'should' sentence (R); 149:7-8 are purpose clauses ending with 、 (L, B) and 149:9 closes with "…ためである。"; R makes each verse a statement as the English R does
decisions.reason: The English L and B run 'to execute … to bind … to execute' on from verse 6; Japanese keeps each verse's content after its own number. romemot 'el "神をあがめる歌" (m1); praise and sword together picture God's judgment through his people (m3).

en.L: to execute vengeance on the nations, punishments on the peoples,
en.B: to bring retribution on the nations and to punish the peoples,
en.R: They will punish the nations and pay them back for the wrong they have done.

fr.L: pour exercer la vengeance sur les nations, des châtiments sur les peuples,

fr.R: Ils puniront les nations et leur feront payer le mal qu’elles ont fait.

es.R: Ellos castigarán a las naciones y les darán su merecido por el mal que han hecho.

vi.L: để thi hành sự báo trả trên các dân tộc, \q những hình phạt trên các dân,
vi.B: để báo trả các dân tộc \q và trừng phạt các dân,
vi.R: Họ sẽ trừng phạt các dân tộc \q và báo trả cho những điều sai trái chúng đã làm.

ko.L: 민족들에게 보복을, \q 백성들에게 벌을 행하려는 것이며,
ko.R: 그들은 민족들을 벌하고, \q 그들이 저지른 잘못을 갚아 줄 것이다.

pt.L: para executar vingança sobre as nações, castigos sobre os povos,
pt.B: para trazer retribuição sobre as nações e castigar os povos,
pt.R: Eles vão castigar as nações e pagar a elas pelo mal que fizeram.

am.B: በሕዝቦች ላይ ፍዳን እንዲያመጡ፣ \q ወገኖችንም እንዲቀጡ፣
am.R: ሕዝቦችን ይቀጣሉ፤ \q ስላደረጉት በደልም ብድራታቸውን ይከፍሏቸዋል።

ru.L: чтобы совершить мщение над народами, наказания над племенами,
ru.B: чтобы воздать народам по справедливости и наказать племена,

decisions.choice: vengeance: just retribution
decisions.reason: The word (neqamah) is the repayment of wrong, here as God's just sentence on nations that have done evil (Deuteronomy 32:41-43), not personal spite.

decisions.choice: punishments: rebukes, chastisements
decisions.reason: The word (tokhechot) is correction or punishment that answers wrongdoing.

decisions.choice: for the wrong they have done
decisions.reason: Readable says what vengeance answers (m1).

decisions.choice: "ሕዝቦች" (nations) and "ወገኖች" (peoples) in one line
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets where goyim and ʾummim stand side by side.
Goyim are जातियाँ at Literal and राष्ट्र or देश at Balanced and Readable, never a caste-sounding word there, as the poetry note settles.

decisions.choice: мщение (L); воздать по справедливости (B)
decisions.reason: The word is just retribution (m1), not private revenge; Balanced says so, Literal keeps the older "мщение", which Russian still uses of just punishment.

decisions.choice: neqamah "復讐" (L), "報い" (B, R); baggoyim "諸国の民" (L, B), "国々" (R); 'ummim "民ら" (L), "もろもろの民" (B)
decisions.reason: Just retribution (m1), as 58:11 and 94:1 (PSA-6, PSA-10); Psalter nation words (PSA-1, 117:1).

es.R: Pondrán en cadenas a los reyes de las naciones y en grilletes de hierro a sus líderes.

ru.L: чтобы связать их царей цепями и их знатных — оковами железными,
ru.B: чтобы заковать их царей в цепи и их знать — в железные оковы,
ru.R: Они закуют царей этих народов в цепи, а их вождей — в железные кандалы.

ja.L: 彼らの王たちを鎖で、彼らの高貴な者たちを鉄のかせで縛るため、
ja.B: その王たちを鎖につなぎ、その高貴な者たちに鉄のかせをはめるため、
ja.R: 彼らは、国々の王たちを鎖につなぎ、その指導者たちに鉄のかせをはめる。

uk.L: щоб звʼязати їхніх царів кайданами, а їхніх вельмож — залізними путами,
uk.B: щоб закути їхніх царів у кайдани, а їхніх вельмож — у залізні пута,
uk.R: Вони закують царів тих народів у кайдани, а їхніх провідників — у залізні пута.

decisions.choice: their honored ones: their nobles
decisions.reason: The word (nikhbadim) is people of rank and honor.

decisions.choice: chained kings: defeat in war
decisions.reason: Kings captured in war were led away in chains (2 Kings 25:7; Isaiah 45:14). The rulers who were called to praise in 148:11 are here those who refused.

source.text: לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם׀מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: to execute on them [the] judgment written. It [is] honor for all his faithful [ones]. Praise Yah!

en.L: to execute on them the judgment written; this [is] honor for all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful [ones]. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: to carry out on them the judgment already written. This honor belongs to all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: They will carry out the judgment God has written down against them. This is an honor for all of God's faithful people. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: pour exécuter sur eux le jugement écrit ; c’[est] un honneur pour tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: pour accomplir sur eux le jugement déjà écrit. Cet honneur revient à tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Ils exécuteront le jugement que Dieu a écrit contre eux. C’est un honneur pour tous les fidèles de Dieu. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: ili kutekeleza juu yao hukumu iliyoandikwa; \q hii [ni] heshima kwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.B: ili kutimiza juu yao hukumu iliyokwisha kuandikwa. \q Heshima hii ni ya waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Watatekeleza hukumu ambayo Mungu ameiandika dhidi yao. \q Hii ni heshima kwa watu wote waaminifu wa Mungu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

es.L: para ejecutar sobre ellos el juicio escrito; esta [es] la honra de todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.B: para llevar a cabo sobre ellos el juicio ya escrito. Esta honra es para todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.R: Llevarán a cabo el juicio que Dios ha escrito contra ellos. Esto es un honor para todo el pueblo fiel de Dios. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!

vi.L: để thi hành trên chúng sự phán xét đã được chép; \q [đó là] vinh dự cho tất cả những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.B: để thi hành trên chúng sự phán xét đã được ghi chép. \q Đây là vinh dự dành cho mọi người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.R: Họ sẽ thi hành sự phán xét Đức Chúa Trời đã ghi chép để nghịch lại chúng. \q Đây là vinh dự cho mọi người trung tín của Đức Chúa Trời. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!

ko.L: 기록된 심판을 그들에게 행하려는 것이다. \q 이것이 그분의 모든 신실한 이들에게 영광이다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!
ko.B: 이미 기록된 심판을 그들에게 집행하려는 것이다. \q 이 영광은 그분의 모든 신실한 백성의 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 그들은 하나님께서 그 민족들에게 내리시려고 적어 두신 심판을 이룰 것이다. \q 이것은 하나님의 모든 신실한 백성에게 영광스러운 일이다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!

pt.L: para executar sobre eles o juízo escrito; esta [é] a honra de todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} fiéis. Aleluia!
pt.B: para executar sobre eles a sentença já escrita. Essa honra pertence a todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} fiéis. Aleluia!
pt.R: Eles vão executar a sentença que Deus escreveu contra elas. Essa é uma honra para todo o povo fiel de Deus. Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}!

am.L: የተጻፈውን ፍርድ በእነርሱ ላይ ያደርጉ ዘንድ፤ \q ይህ ለታማኞቹ ሁሉ ክብር [ነው]። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!
am.B: አስቀድሞ የተጻፈውን ፍርድ በእነርሱ ላይ እንዲፈጽሙ ነው። \q ይህ ክብር ለታማኞቹ ሁሉ ነው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!
am.R: እግዚአብሔር በእነርሱ ላይ የጻፈውን ፍርድ ይፈጽማሉ። \q ይህ ለእግዚአብሔር ታማኝ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ክብር ነው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!

hi.L: कि उन पर लिखा हुआ दंड पूरा करें; यह उनके सब भक्तों का सम्मान [है]। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!
hi.B: कि उन पर पहले से लिखा हुआ न्याय पूरा करें। यह सम्मान उनके सब विश्वासयोग्य लोगों का है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!
hi.R: वे उनके विरुद्ध वह न्याय पूरा करेंगे जो परमेश्वर ने लिख रखा है। यह परमेश्वर के सब विश्वासयोग्य लोगों के लिए सम्मान की बात है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!

ru.L: чтобы совершить над ними суд написанный; это — честь для всех {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} верных. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!
ru.B: чтобы исполнить над ними уже записанный приговор. Эта честь принадлежит всем {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} верным. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!
ru.R: Они исполнят над ними приговор, который записал Бог. Это честь для всех верных Богу людей. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!

ja.L: 書き記された裁きを彼らに行うためである。これは、その方のすべての誠実な者たちの誉れ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！
ja.B: すでに書き記された裁きを、彼らに行うためである。これは、その方に誠実なすべての人たちの誉れである。{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！
ja.R: 彼らは、神が書き記された裁きを、国々に行う。これは、神に忠実なすべての人たちにとって、誉れである。{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！

uk.L: щоб виконати над ними написаний присуд; це — честь для всіх {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вірних. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!
uk.B: щоб здійснити над ними присуд, що вже написаний. Ця честь належить усім {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вірним. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!
uk.R: Вони виконають вирок, який Бог записав проти них. Це честь для всіх вірних Божих людей. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!

decisions.choice: the judgment written: the sentence God has decreed
decisions.reason: "Written" may mean decreed by God, as if written in his book (Isaiah 65:6), or written in Scripture, in God's warnings against the nations (Deuteronomy 32:41-43).

decisions.choice: it is honor: this task is an honor
alternatives: he is the honor of all his faithful
decisions.reason: "It" most likely is the carrying out of God's judgment just described. It could also be read as "he (God) is the glory of all his faithful".

decisions.choice: the faithful: people of loyal love
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is related to chesed, loyal love: people who hold fast to the LORD in love and loyalty (4:4).

decisions.choice: God has written down; God's faithful people
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who decreed the judgment and whose people they are (m1).

decisions.choice: mishpat katuv "書き記された裁き" (L, B), "神が書き記された裁き" (R); hadar "誉れ"
decisions.reason: The sentence God has decreed (m1, uncertain); the task itself is the honour (m2, uncertain).

decisions.choice: hallelu-yah, one fixed form through Psalms 146-150: "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！" (L, B), "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule (PSA-1, PSA-11): Yah is {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}, the call 〜せよ (L, B), R 〜しよう since God's people are called; the closing Hallel takes the exclamation form used in 111-113 and 135, the same at the head and foot of every psalm.
